__broaden__.αἴσιμα: αἴσιμος — fitting, right, according to what is destined; neut. acc. pl., object of εἰδώς: ’what is fitting’ · also object of τίσειν: ’everything that is fitting, what is due’ · also object of τίουσι, neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’the proper deeds’ (αἴσιμα ἔργ’ ἀνθρώπων) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’all that is fitting, in due measure’ (ἀμείνω δ’ αἴσιμα πάντα)
__broaden__.αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, in this very way; adv. (ὣς δ’ αὔτως ’and in just the same way’) · also ’simply, without more’, of words alone (ἦ αὔτως ἐπέεσσιν ’or simply with words’) · also ’simply, idly, without more ado’, of sitting (αὔτως ἧσται ’sits idle’) · also ’without more, empty-handed’, of sending away with no gift (αὔτως ἀππέμψει ’will send us off with nothing’)
__broaden__.βάλετ: βάλλω — throw; aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided (βάλετ’ = βάλετο); in tmesis περὶ … βάλετ’ ’threw around (oneself)’ · also with ἐπί governing the dative: ’threw upon (his shoulders)’ (ἐπὶ στιβαροῖς βάλετ’ ὤμοις)
__broaden__.κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’) · also + subj. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ ποθι Ζεὺς δώῃ ’if Zeus should somehow grant’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ τιν’ … εὕρωμεν ’if we should find any’) · also + opt. in the protasis after αἴ: ’if perhaps’ (αἴ κέ μοι … παρασταίης ’if you would stand by me’) · also + aor. indic., unreal past: τῷ κέ με … ὤνησεν ’would have benefited me’ · also + fut./short-vowel aor. subj. in a main clause: κέ τοι καταλέξω ’I shall tell you’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἴ: ’if perhaps’ (εἴ κέ μιν ἀγγείλαιμι ’if I might report him’) · also + subj. after εἰς ὅ, ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ τοι φήνωσι ’until they show you’)
__broaden__.κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also + secondary indic. (κατέφθιτο), unreal past conditional: ’would have perished’ · also + aor. indic. of a future event pictured as already accomplished, an eventual near-certainty rather than a counterfactual: ἤ κεν ... κτεῖνεν ’or he may well have killed (him) already’ · also + subj. in a relative clause, prospective: ’who is to, who will’ (ἥ κεν ἄγῃσι ’(a wagon) that shall carry’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … δαινύῃ ’whenever you feast’) · also + subj. in the protasis of a condition after αἴ: ’if ever’ · also + opt., potential: ’might, may’ · also + opt. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἰ δέ κεν … ἀφικοίμεθα ’but if we should reach’) · also + fut. indic. or short-vowel subj. in an apodosis: ’will’ (αἶψά κεν … τεύξομεν ’at once we will build’) · also + subj. in the protasis after εἰ: ’if ever’ (εἴ κεν … ἵκωμαι ’if I should come’) · also + subj. in a disjunctive statement of what may happen: ’may’ (ἤ κεν ἁλώῃ ’or he may be caught’) · also + subj. in a general relative: ’whoever’ (ὅς κεν ὀπυίῃ ’whoever marries’)
__broaden__.παιπαλοέσσης: παιπαλόεις — rugged, craggy; fem. gen. sg. παιπαλοέσσης, agreeing with Χίοιο (the island-name Chios treated as feminine) · also fem. gen. sg., agreeing with Σάμοιο (Same, an island treated as feminine)
__broaden__.πηνελοπείῃ: Πηνελόπεια — Penelope; dat. sg., dat. of comparison · also dat. sg., indirect object: ’to Penelope’ (ἐρέοντα περίφρονι Πηνελοπείῃ ’to tell prudent Penelope’)
__broaden__.σιγαλόεντα: σιγαλόεις — glossy, gleaming (sense uncertain); neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χιτῶνα: ’gleaming’
__broaden__.φαίνεται: φαίνω — show, make appear; pres. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’appears, is plain to see’ · also + inf., ’seems (to be)’ (ἀρίστη φαίνεται εἶναι ’seems to be the best’)
__broaden__.ἱέμενοι: ἵεμαι — long for, strain toward, be eager; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’longing’ (οἴκαδε ἱέμενοι ’longing for home’) · also + inf.: ’eager (to do)’ (ἱέμενοι κτεῖναι ’eager to kill’)
